$comment: Balancing targets the reports check (min/max). Shares are fractions (0.45 = 45 %), times are seconds. Proposed 2026-11-15, change them here when the design changes. Path targets (path*) agreed with Ilja 2026-11-16; path profile (pathMainShare, pathDistinct, pathCommit) and free picks (pick*) agreed 2026-11-16 (PR #16); metaHero agreed 2026-11-16 (PR #18).

fightSeconds.what: average fight length in every round

longestFight.what: longest fight of a round (one minute of waiting at speed ×1 is too long)

supernovaReached.what: share of fights that reach the Supernova, every round

supernovaLasts90.what: nine in ten Supernova fights are over this many seconds after it starts

heroWinShare.what: win share of every hero, overall and in each third of the run

recipeLift.what: how much more often a hero wins while holding a recipe result than the same hero in the same round without it

recipeMadeShare.what: share of a hero's runs that make the same recipe result (one chain everyone takes)

pathHeroWinShare.what: win share of the hero over all its bots (paths and open) against other heroes

pathWinShare.what: win share of every path, all rounds

pathLateWinShare.what: win share of every path in the last third of the run

pathOverOpen.what: every path wins at least this much more often than the hero's open bot (no path), so following a path pays

pathMainShare.what: path profile: the path's main damage mechanic is at least this share of its damage (rounds 9+)

pathDistinct.what: path profile: every two paths of a hero differ at least this much in their damage mix (1 - cosine similarity; 0 = same mix)

pathCommit.what: share of the final build's item cost that belongs to the bot's path

pathSpread.what: gap between the hero's best and weakest path, all rounds

pickGain.what: general artifact: gain over the rest of the run compared with the median artifact (× median)

pickBest.what: general artifact: share of its offers (3 shown) in which it is the best choice (fair: 33 %)

pickWorst.what: general artifact: share of its offers (3 shown) in which it is the worst choice (fair: 33 %)

pickFloor.what: general artifact: gain for every single hero, compared with the median artifact (no hero gets a useless pick)

pickEmpty.what: general artifact: share of a hero's offers in which no option reaches the pickFloor

pickHeroGain.what: hero item: gain over the rest of the run compared with the median hero item (× median)

pickHeroBest.what: hero item: share of its offers (2 shown) in which it is the better choice (fair: 50 %)

pickHeroWorst.what: hero item: share of its offers (2 shown) in which it is the weaker choice (fair: 50 %)

metaHero.what: share of every hero in a settled meta of the path-against-path table (fair: 25 %); wide on purpose, it only catches blunders

selftestNoise.what: self-test: two independent runs differ by about as much as their ± says (root mean square of z, 1 = honest)

selftestBoost.what: self-test: a path made 25 % stronger rises by at least this many standard errors
